c74object.name: el.convolver~
c74object.description:
el.convolver~ performs offline, buffer-based convolution between a source audio buffer and an impulse response buffer, writing the peak-normalized result into a destination buffer. Because it operates non-realtime rather than in the live signal chain, it can process very long impulse responses efficiently. The destination buffer is automatically resized if necessary to accommodate the full duration of the convolution result. Built-in impulse generation routines (noiseimp and spikeimp) can also synthesize test impulses directly into the impulse buffer.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (messages): Control inlet. Accepts messages to trigger convolution (convolve, convolvechans), synthesize impulses (noiseimp, spikeimp), or manage processing memory (static_memory).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (bang): Completion bang. Emits a bang when a convolution calculation or impulse synthesis operation has completed.

inlet.description: Receives messages that initiate convolution or synthesize impulse responses.

outlet.description: Sends a bang when convolution or impulse generation finishes.

objarg.name: source-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ holding the source sound to be convolved.

objarg.name: impulse-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ holding the impulse response (default: impulse_buf).

objarg.name: destination-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ where the convolution result will be stored (default: dest_buf). The buffer will automatically be expanded if it is shorter than the combined length of the source and impulse.

method.name: convolve
method.description:
Executes convolution using automatic channel routing. Sends a bang from the outlet when finished. This operates under the following channel configurations:
1) Source, impulse, and destination all have the same channel count.
2) Source is mono (1 channel), while impulse and destination share the same channel count.
3) Impulse is mono (1 channel), while source and destination share the same channel count.
For custom routing between different channel configurations, use convolvechans.

method.name: convolvechans
method.description: Convolves single channels specified as a 3-element list: [source_channel, impulse_channel, destination_channel]. Channels are 1-indexed. Sends a bang from the outlet when complete.

method.name: noiseimp
method.description: Fills the impulse buffer with an exponentially decaying burst of white noise. The slope argument controls the envelope decay shape: negative values produce a concave curve, while positive values produce a convex curve. Sends a bang from the outlet when complete.

method.name: spikeimp
method.description: Fills the impulse buffer with a decaying series of discrete impulses (spikes). The density argument specifies the average number of spikes per second. Sends a bang from the outlet when complete.

method.name: static_memory
method.description: When set to 1, working memory sized to the current impulse buffer is allocated and retained. This eliminates memory allocation overhead when triggering convolution during live performance. Once enabled, do not resize the impulse or destination buffers. Setting to 0 disables static memory mode.
